programme.title: Football: Spanish league: RCD Espanyol – FC Barcelona
programme.desc: In theory, the league schedule gives the Pride of Catalonia a chance to welcome 2026 in style. The defeat in the Barcelona derby is something that has been happening to it for a long time. The last one took place eight years ago, when Espanyol defeated their more successful rival from behind 1-0 in the quarter-finals of the King's Cup. However, it was a pyrrhic victory. Ernesto Valverde's team at that time reversed the two-legged tie in the second leg at Camp Nou and celebrated promotion to the next phase of the competition. In the 2025/26 league campaign, the Parrots have arguments to pose a real threat to Blaugrana, who are aiming for the championship. The team from Estadi Cornella-El Prat achieved a series of victories in November and December. She defeated, among others: Sevilla, Celta and Athletic, which moved it to fifth place in the table, which resulted in promotion to the European cups. The meeting with the Pride of Catalonia will be a maturity exam for Espanyol. If the Parrots take points away from Hansi Flick's team, they will show that they can still cause a stir at the top of La Liga

programme.title: I was the king – Paweł Brożek | S01E05
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Paweł Brożek scored 149 goals in the Polish Ekstraklasa. This places him in eighth place in the all-time ranking of the highest league in our country. His goals contributed to Wisła Kraków winning seven Polish champion titles. Paweł Brożek became the top scorer twice. Poland. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Riding for gold. Speedway on wiretapping | E04
programme.desc: We follow the competition in the PGE Ekstraliga. In the years 2022-2024, ORLEN OIL Motor Lublin won the Polish champion title three times in a row. Betard Sparta Wrocław, on the other hand, regularly reached the finals in recent seasons. In 2025, Pres Grupa Deweloperska Toruń unexpectedly joined the fight for gold... documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E03
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. Faced with increasingly poor results, Vern and Leon are forced to look for areas richer in the precious metal. Moving the entire operation to another location is quite a challenge. The Clarks are still hesitant to take the risk and invest in modern gold screening equipment. They realize that the fate of their entire life savings depends on this decision. Meanwhile, Kellie and Henri reach the edge of the salt lake Lefroy. The searchers head further into the wild wasteland. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions - The way to the top | E01
programme.desc: The life story of young lions. The everyday challenges they have to face throughout their adolescence will be shown. The camera also captures conflicts between them, when the mother returns to her children with a new offspring. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Cheetahs on a hot plain | E03
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. A slender build, black spots on light fur, hyperventilation and regular licking to evaporate saliva - these are the cheetah's most effective tricks to help it survive in high temperatures. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: d/f Nazca Lines: Buried Secrets. Update
programme.desc: The greatest secret of the Peruvian Atacama Desert is the geoglyphs on the Nazca Plateau, which are more than 1000 years old and are visible only from the air. With the help of the first 3D maps of these now iconic outlines, and after solving the mystery of the burial of a headless man, archaeologists and scientists have suggested that the geoglyphs were used by the Nazca Indians as unique open-air temples in which they worshiped their gods of fertility and water. The use of drones, which are much more advanced for such research compared to the robotic helicopters used a decade ago, allowed scientists to discover 50 new geoglyphs. Many of these newly discovered images come from the Paracas culture, which predates the Nazca era, and researchers now have a better understanding of the region's geoglyph-making tradition, which dates back much earlier than previously thought, before the birth of Christ. USA, 2018

programme.title: d/f Lost Treasures of the Mayan Snake Kings
programme.desc: A documentary about a fascinating archaeological dig in the jungles of Central America - one of the last great frontiers of archaeology. Over the course of several decades, archaeologists have slowly uncovered the secrets of the ancient Mayan civilization, their achievements and cultural heritage. The film immerses viewers in the complex and exciting process of excavation, showing how the life of the Mayans is gradually reconstructed and their historical secrets, hidden in the green expanses of the rainforest, are revealed. Dir.: Laura Balfour, James Lavelle. UK, 2017

programme.title: d/f Big cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: The Serengeti is a region in East Africa that is home to about seventy species of large mammals. The documentary will introduce channel viewers to some of the most notable and interesting inhabitants of these places: lions and cheetahs. The plot centers on several families, each of them daily fighting a difficult struggle for survival in the savannah. Here are just a few real-life wildlife stories that would be the envy of any film writer. Two lion cubs, born during the dry season, find themselves on the brink of starvation because their mother Kali runs out of milk. Desperate to feed her cubs, she finds and eats the carcass of a dead hippopotamus... A lonely male cheetah, Moto, falls in love with Nyota. At first they become friends, and soon start a family. But one day Nyota disappears, and Moto goes in search of her across the endless African plains. Dir.: Jongyul Lee. South Korea, 2019

programme.title: Chasing Monsters – Monsterfische am Haken

programme.desc: A pregnant female ring-tailed lemur is seriously injured in a fight. Is your unborn baby in danger? Meanwhile, the staff welcomes new arrivals to the zoo, five cute capybaras. (Station info).

programme.title: The baboon gangs of Victoria Falls

programme.title: Gladiators

programme.title: Islands: Nature's Wild Laboratories

programme.title: Islands: Nature's Wild Laboratories
programme.desc: The small stature of Borneo's dwarf elephants is due to a biological phenomenon: Due to their threatened habitat, the pachyderms have shrunk over generations. (Station info).

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: Tourists appreciate the beaches, the weather and the culture of life. But there is more to discover in the Caribbean island world. Between the Bahamas, Grand Cayman and Costa Rica, “Terra X” accompanies researchers as they dive into cave systems, breed rare blue iguanas and observe clever white-shouldered capuchins.

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: For many Europeans, the area between the Hawaiian Islands, New Zealand and Easter Island is still synonymous with beaches and rainforests. But paradise is subject to strong forces: volcanism, hurricanes and tidal waves shape and threaten the island world.

programme.title: Dream destinations in Southeast Asia

programme.title: Dream destinations in Southeast Asia
programme.desc: From Myanmar it goes via Lao and Cambodia to Thailand - the world-famous temple complex of Angkor Wat and the mighty Mekong, the "mother of all water".

programme.title: The Alps
programme.desc: Hardly any region is as diverse as the Alps. The mountains stretch across eight countries at an altitude of over 4,000 meters from the Ligurian Sea to the Pannonian Basin. Brown bears were considered extinct in most of the high mountains. There is now a small population of around 100 animals again. Lynx and Alpine ibex also returned. Marmots eat bacon on the alpine pastures. Your big enemy: the golden eagle. \n\nThe film team shot for over four years.

programme.title: Wonderful world of the Pacific & wild Antarctica
programme.desc: The “underwater highways” bring well-traveled guests such as blue whales to seasonal feeding grounds and, with the world's largest quantities of krill, form the basis of the spectacular biodiversity on distant coasts and islands.

programme.title: HAZARDOUS HISTORY WITH HENRY WINKLER S1 EP05

programme.title: NHÍM SONIC - SONIC THE HEDGEHOG 3
programme.desc: Sonic, Knuckles và Tails đã trở lại cho cuộc phiêu lưu hoành tráng nhất của họ. Cả nhóm đoàn tụ để đối mặt với kẻ thù đáng gờm mới, Shadow.

programme.title: SIÊU NHÂN II - SUPERMAN II
programme.desc: Cuộc chiến vũ trụ giành quyền thống trị thế giới bắt đầu khi Superman vô tình thả ba người Kyrptonians bị lưu đày mạnh mẽ và phải ngăn chặn họ bằng mọi giá!

programme.title: SIÊU NHÂN III - SUPERMAN III
programme.desc: Trong phần thứ ba của loạt phim này, Superman chiến đấu với siêu máy tính và tên doanh nhân độc ác đang lợi dụng nó.

programme.title: SANTA THÂN MẾN - DEAR SANTA
programme.desc: Khi một cậu bé gửi danh sách mong muốn Giáng sinh của mình cho ông già Noel với một lỗi chính tả nghiêm trọng, Jack Black độc ác đã đến để tàn phá ngày lễ.

programme.title: CÔNG VIÊN KỈ JURA - JURASSIC PARK
programme.desc: Kiệt tác của Steven Spielberg theo sau một nhóm các nhà khoa học trên một hòn đảo để chứng kiến ​​những con khủng long thực sự trong một công viên, chỉ để thấy mọi thứ đi sai khi một cơn bão ập đến.

programme.title: SÁT THỦ GIÀ - OLD GUY
programme.desc: Daniel rất vui mừng khi công ty kéo anh ta trở lại lĩnh vực này, nhưng chỉ để đào tạo người mới Gen Z Wihlborg, một kẻ ám sát thần đồng với thái độ.

programme.title: NOSFERATU: MA CÀ RỒNG - NOSFERATU
programme.desc: Câu chuyện ngụ ngôn Gothic theo sau một phụ nữ trẻ đang bị ám ảnh bởi một ma cà rồng Transylvania cổ đại, mang theo kinh dị chưa được kể với anh ta.

programme.title: BÙA PHÉP - SPELL
programme.desc: Một người đàn ông rơi xuống Appalachia và tỉnh dậy và thấy mình bị mắc kẹt bởi một học viên Hoodoo truyền thống. Để cứu gia đình, anh phải thoát khỏi cô trước khi mặt trăng máu mọc lên.

Sun Wu Kong quyết định trở lại quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng sức mạnh thiêng liêng của anh ta không ổn định sau khi mất đi cái vòng vàng, và anh ta phải tìm người trẻ hơn để hợp tác để tìm ra sức mạnh của thời gian. programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL

programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới đang hỗn loạn sau khi Cây sự sống bị cháy. Sun Wu Kong quyết định trở lại quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng sức mạnh thiêng liêng của anh ta không ổn định sau khi mất đi cái vòng vàng, và anh ta phải tìm người trẻ hơn để hợp tác để tìm ra sức mạnh của thời gian. Vì con khỉ macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian, chúng đụng độ trong một trận chiến khốc liệt

programme.title: ĐIỆP VỤ ĐẢO QUỶ - OPERATION BANGKOK
programme.desc: Cựu chiến binh quân sự Wu và Cop Cop Ming Cứu hộ Cứu hộ trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Khi WU phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt, anh ta ở lại với Ming để chiến đấu với những tên côn đồ và cứu cô.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!
